annotations.title: Test an automation on a sample

description: Ask an automation what it WOULD do, without it doing anything: an alert channel judged on an event name (event: {name: 'post.failed'}), a comment-to-DM automation on a sample comment (event: {text, platformPostId}), a Google Ads rule as a dry run on the account as it is now, a boost automation on the brand's recent measured posts (subjectId narrows to one post). Answers wouldRun, what matched and the steps it would take. sample:true returns a body to start from. Nothing is sent, written or spent. Free.

event.description: the sample event, shaped by the automation kind

id.description: the automation id from list_automations (meta_rule:…, google_rule:…, tiktok_rule:…, boost:…, alerts:…, dm:…, refill)

sample.description: true = just return a sample body

name: test_automation
title: Test an automation on a sample
